Package com.csse3200.game.components.shop

Class HigherLowerGame

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.shop.HigherLowerGame
public final class HigherLowerGame extends Object
Higher/Lower card-guessing logic: guess whether the next card is higher or lower than the current one. Each correct guess grows a multiplier; the player can cash out at any time or keep pushing their luck until a wrong guess loses the stake.

Pure logic, no UI, following the same split as CoinFlipGame.
